rules.rule: pytest and pytest-asyncio (auto mode). Flag tests that cannot fail or assert nothing meaningful, tests deleted, weakened, skipped or xfailed to make code pass, shared mutable state or a shared database between tests, missing cleanup, sleeps and wall-clock time instead of an injected clock, over-mocking that hides real behaviour, and float comparisons where exact values are expected.

Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2 async, psycopg 3, Pydantic v2, aio-pika. Flag incorrect logic and edge cases, blocking calls inside async code, a session or transaction used outside its scope, missing commit or rollback, N+1 queries, SQL built by string formatting, race conditions and missing locks, swallowed or overly broad exceptions, mutable default arguments, float where Decimal is needed, unsafe or missing type hints, and secrets or prints in logs. Architecture (modular monolith): flag imports across modules other than public.py, I/O, clocks, logging or framework code in domain/, application code importing infrastructure/ or presentation/, SQL outside infrastructure/, and a message handler that is not idempotent or acknowledges before its commit.

Alembic and PostgreSQL 16. Flag migrations that are not reversible or lose data without a guard, locking DDL on large tables, missing constraints or indexes for the queries that use them, and more than one head.

React, TypeScript (strict), Mantine, TanStack Query, MSW, Vitest and Testing Library. Flag incorrect logic, wrong hook usage (rules of hooks, missing or wrong dependencies, stale closures), state that should be derived, unstable query keys, cache invalidation missing after mutations, unhandled loading and error states, any or unsafe casts, accessibility problems, and business calculations done in the browser instead of the API.

GitHub Actions, GNU Make and bash. Flag failures that can pass silently (`|| true`, continue-on-error, missing set -euo pipefail, ignored exit codes), pull_request_target, actions not pinned by full commit SHA, permissions wider than needed, untrusted PR input interpolated into scripts, missing timeout-minutes, and non-portable shell.
